summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, without committing or running any code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry ("\x1b]0;{title}\x07") and the Control.title classmethod, which passes the title as a single two-item tuple; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title(title) once; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title (returns early on legacy consoles), and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only renderer test). Nothing was run, so the tests and mypy are unverified.
